scope: prospective common16 temporal ablation after retained common8 development failures; no sealed test

groot.decoder: native normalized MIN_MAX values clip to[-1,1], invert q01/q99, then compose relative arm actions with current state; final absolute commands can still exceed joint limits

act.decoder: native MEAN_STD inverse transform, unbounded policy-decoded commands
act.external_router: Exact instruction chooses one independently trained controller; no text tokens or neural language grounding

instructions.red-left: Pick up the red cube and put it in the left tray.
instructions.red-right: Pick up the red cube and put it in the right tray.

development.retention: full fresh native chunks, remote-verified input hashes, first three RGB/state inputs, separate synchronized server timing

teacher_forcing.first8_metric: predicted absolute6-radian commands versus expert actions[t:t+8]
teacher_forcing.retain: all full predicted chunks; actual input pixel/state/text hashes; server-synchronized and end-to-end latency
teacher_forcing.scope: training-scene diagnostic; original recorded RGB backend, not a robot-success trial

grader.task_success: independent measured lift, whole-object destination containment/floor contact, release,45-frame stability, distractors and order
grader.strict_success: task_success AND zero violations by policy-decoded commands before common actuator supervisor
grader.limit_metric: post-native-decoder/pre-common-supervisor commands; not raw logits/diffusion head compliance
grader.supervisor: same existing simulator actuator target clipping to authored six-joint ranges for every model; no IK/manual correction

timing.server: CUDA-synchronized native policy processing excluding PNG decode and SSH
timing.end_to_end: includes PNG encode/SSH/server processing; simulation paused
timing.comparison: no cross CPU/WAN hardware speed claim
